member.name: NS:System#System
member.summary: Root namespace for Business Central system infrastructure, providing core platform functionality and fundamental services. Contains essential system interfaces, base types, and foundational components for Business Central platform operations.
member.remarks: This namespace serves as the foundation for all Business Central system functionality, containing core interfaces, fundamental types, and essential platform services. Provides the base infrastructure upon which all other system namespaces build their specialized functionality. Core functionality: System interfaces, base types, platform fundamentals, and infrastructure services.

member.name: NS:System#System#Reflection
member.summary: Provides reflection and metadata capabilities for Business Central object introspection and dynamic operations. Manages runtime object inspection, metadata access, and dynamic type operations for advanced scenarios.
member.remarks: This namespace contains reflection infrastructure including object metadata access, runtime type inspection, dynamic operation support, and object introspection capabilities. Supports extensibility through custom reflection events and metadata processing for advanced integration scenarios. Core functionality: Object reflection, metadata access, type inspection, and dynamic operations.

member.name: NS:System#System#Apps
member.summary: Manages application lifecycle, installation, and metadata for Business Central apps and extensions. Provides app management functionality including installation tracking, data archiving, and tenant-level app operations.
member.remarks: This namespace encompasses app installation management, tenant-specific app operations, data archiving, and add-in management. Supports app lifecycle events, installation validation, and tenant app configuration. Core functionality: App installation tracking, tenant operations, data archiving, and add-in management. Integrates with the AL runtime, app management services, and tenant provisioning systems.

member.name: NS:System#System#Environment
member.summary: Provides core environment management functionality for Business Central tenants including companies, media, and licensing. Manages tenant-level resources, media storage, thumbnails, and fundamental environment configuration.
member.remarks: This namespace contains essential tenant environment components including company management, media file storage, thumbnail generation, and license state tracking. Supports multi-company scenarios, media optimization, and tenant-specific resource management with cloud-optimized storage patterns. Core functionality: Company definitions, media management, thumbnail processing, and license state tracking.

member.name: NS:System#System#Environment#Configuration
member.summary: Manages user and tenant-level configuration including profiles, personalization, and UI customization. Provides configuration persistence for user preferences, profile extensions, and page customizations.
member.remarks: This namespace handles all aspects of user experience customization including profile management, page personalization, report layout selection, and style sheet preferences. Supports in-client profile configuration, AL compilation for customizations, and tenant-level configuration storage. Core functionality: Profile management, page customization, personalization storage, and UI preferences. Integrates with AL compilation services, user interface frameworks, and tenant customization systems.

member.name: NS:System#System#Environment#Consumption
member.summary: Tracks and analyzes user consumption patterns and resource usage for Business Central features and services. Provides detailed logging and monitoring of user activities for billing, analytics, and capacity planning.
member.remarks: This namespace enables tracking of user consumption events including feature usage, resource consumption, and service utilization. Supports billing calculations, usage analytics, and performance monitoring with detailed user attribution and temporal tracking. Core functionality: Consumption logging, usage tracking, billing support, and resource monitoring.

member.name: NS:System#System#Security
member.summary: Provides core security infrastructure for Business Central including session management and data sensitivity. Manages security fundamentals, session tracking, and data classification for security compliance.
member.remarks: This namespace contains essential security components including active session management, session event tracking, and data sensitivity classification. Supports security auditing, session monitoring, and data protection compliance with event logging and sensitivity management. Core functionality: Session management, security events, and data sensitivity classification.

member.name: NS:System#System#Security#AccessControl
member.summary: Implements access control and permission management for Business Central security. Manages users, permissions, device registration, and access control mechanisms across the platform.
member.remarks: This namespace provides the complete access control framework including user management, permission sets, device registration, and access control enforcement. Supports role-based security, permission inheritance, device-based licensing, and user account management with Azure AD integration. Core functionality: User management, permission control, device registration, and access enforcement. Integrates with Azure Active Directory, permission frameworks, and authentication services.

member.name: NS:System#System#Security#Authentication
member.summary: Manages authentication mechanisms and secure storage for Business Central security infrastructure. Provides token management, isolated storage, and secure credential handling for authentication services.
member.remarks: This namespace contains authentication support infrastructure including secure token caching, isolated storage for sensitive data, and credential management. Supports OAuth flows, secure storage patterns, and authentication token lifecycle management with encryption and isolation. Core functionality: Token management, secure storage, and authentication infrastructure.

member.name: NS:System#System#Integration
member.summary: Manages external integrations and data synchronization including Intelligent Cloud migration and external events. Provides integration framework for cloud migration, external service notifications, and data synchronization.
member.remarks: This namespace facilitates integration with external systems through cloud migration services, webhook notifications, external event processing, and intelligent cloud data synchronization. Supports hybrid scenarios, external service communication, and automated data migration processes. Core functionality: Cloud migration, external events, webhook management, and data synchronization.

member.name: NS:System#System#Upgrade
member.summary: Manages system upgrades, version transitions, and data transformation during Business Central platform updates. Provides upgrade framework, version management, and compatibility handling for seamless system evolution.
member.remarks: This namespace contains upgrade infrastructure including version management, compatibility checking, upgrade procedure orchestration, and data transformation during platform updates. Supports extensibility through custom upgrade events and transformation logic for smooth version transitions. Core functionality: System upgrades, version management, compatibility handling, and upgrade orchestration.

member.name: O:Table::System#Reflection#CodeUnit Metadata
member.summary: Virtual table that provides metadata information about codeunits in the system.
member.remarks: This table exposes metadata about codeunits including their properties, subtype, permissions, and application associations. Essential for reflection scenarios, development tools, and runtime analysis of codeunit characteristics. member.name: O:Table::System#Reflection#System Object
member.summary: Virtual table that provides low-level system object information including metadata and source code access. This table enables deep introspection of object definitions and is used for system administration and development tools.
member.remarks: The System Object table provides system-level access to object definitions including compiled metadata, source code, and object characteristics. This table is primarily used by development tools, debuggers, and system administration utilities that require deep access to object structures and implementation details. It includes binary metadata storage, AL source code access, and hash verification for object integrity. This table is only available in on-premises deployments where full system access is permitted and is essential for advanced development and diagnostic scenarios. Access to this table requires elevated permissions due to its sensitive nature.

member.name: O:Table::System#Reflection#Table Metadata
member.summary: Virtual table that provides metadata information about all tables in the system. This table enables introspection of table properties, settings, and characteristics for development and administration purposes.
member.remarks: The Table Metadata table is a fundamental metadata source that provides detailed information about table definitions, properties, and configuration settings. It includes information about table types, data classification, permissions, and various table attributes. This table is essential for development tools, metadata analyzers, and administrative utilities that need to understand table structures and properties. The information covers both base application tables and those added by extensions, providing a complete view of the data model.

member.name: O:Table::System#Reflection#XmlPort Metadata
member.summary: Virtual table that provides metadata information about all XMLports in the system. This table enables introspection of XMLport properties, data exchange configurations, and import/export characteristics.
member.remarks: The XMLport Metadata table is essential for understanding XMLport definitions and their data exchange capabilities. It includes detailed information about XMLport formats, encoding settings, transaction types, and directional configurations for data import and export operations. This table is crucial for data integration management, XML processing configuration, and administrative utilities that need to understand XMLport behaviors and constraints. The information covers all XMLport types including XML, fixed text, and variable text formats, providing visibility into the data exchange infrastructure across all applications.

member.summary: Stores metadata for Business Central applications (extensions) that are currently installed in the tenant.
member.remarks: This table maintains a registry of all installed applications with their version information, compatibility details, and publishing metadata. It tracks application identity through App ID and Package ID, provides version control through major/minor/build/revision numbers, and stores compatibility requirements. member.name: O:Table::System#Environment#Configuration#Feature Key

member.remarks: The Feature Key table is central to Business Central's feature management system, allowing administrators to control which preview features and optional functionality is enabled in their environment. The table includes details about mandatory adoption dates, data update requirements, and one-way enablement restrictions that help ensure smooth feature transitions.

member.name: O:Table::System#Security#AccessControl#Permission Range
member.summary: Virtual table that provides information about permission ranges defined for object access control. This table enables understanding of permissions granted for ranges of objects in the security system.
member.remarks: The Permission Range table is fundamental to Business Central's security model, providing detailed information about permissions granted for ranges of objects rather than individual objects. It defines access rights (Read, Insert, Modify, Delete, Execute) for ranges of tables, pages, reports, codeunits, and other AL objects. This table is essential for security administration, permission analysis, and ensuring proper access control across the system. This table is only available in on-premises deployments where direct permission inspection is required for security auditing and compliance purposes.

member.name: O:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers
member.summary: Provides business events for extending application upgrade functionality including precondition checks, upgrade operations, validation, and post-upgrade commit operations.
member.remarks: This codeunit serves as an extensibility layer for the application upgrade process, enabling partners and developers to implement custom upgrade logic, perform validation checks, execute data migration tasks, and handle post-upgrade operations. All events are business events that follow the standard upgrade workflow phases and can be subscribed to by external extensions.

member.name: M:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers.OnCheckPreconditionsPerDatabase
member.summary: Business event that is triggered during the precondition check phase of upgrade at the database level.
member.remarks: Use this event to implement custom precondition validations that must pass before upgrade can proceed. Perform database-level checks such as data integrity validation, required configurations, or compatibility assessments that apply across all companies in the database.

member.name: M:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers.OnCheckPreconditionsPerCompany
member.summary: Business event that is triggered during the precondition check phase of upgrade at the company level.
member.remarks: Use this event to implement custom precondition validations that must pass before upgrade can proceed for a specific company. Perform company-specific checks such as data validation, configuration requirements, or business rule compliance that must be satisfied before upgrade operations begin.

member.name: M:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers.OnUpgradePerDatabase
member.summary: Business event that is triggered during the main upgrade phase at the database level.
member.remarks: Use this event to implement custom upgrade logic that applies at the database level, such as system table modifications, global configuration updates, or cross-company data transformations. This event runs once per database during the upgrade process.

member.name: M:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers.OnUpgradePerCompany
member.summary: Business event that is triggered during the main upgrade phase at the company level.
member.remarks: Use this event to implement custom upgrade logic that applies to individual companies, such as company-specific data migrations, configuration updates, or business rule implementations. This event runs once per company during the upgrade process.

member.name: M:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers.OnValidateUpgradePerDatabase
member.summary: Business event that is triggered during the validation phase of upgrade at the database level.
member.remarks: Use this event to implement custom validation logic that verifies upgrade success at the database level. Perform checks to ensure that database-level upgrade operations completed successfully and that the system is in a consistent state.

member.name: M:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers.OnValidateUpgradePerCompany
member.summary: Business event that is triggered during the validation phase of upgrade at the company level.
member.remarks: Use this event to implement custom validation logic that verifies upgrade success for individual companies. Perform company-specific checks to ensure that all upgrade operations completed successfully and that company data is in a consistent, usable state.

member.name: M:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers.OnAfterUpgradeCommitPerDatabase
member.summary: Business event that is triggered after upgrade operations are committed at the database level.
member.remarks: Use this event to implement post-upgrade operations that should execute after all database-level upgrade changes have been successfully committed. Perform cleanup operations, trigger external integrations, or execute final configuration steps that depend on completed upgrade operations.

member.name: M:Codeunit::System#Upgrade#Upgrade Triggers.OnAfterUpgradeCommitPerCompany
member.summary: Business event that is triggered after upgrade operations are committed at the company level.
member.remarks: Use this event to implement post-upgrade operations that should execute after all company-level upgrade changes have been successfully committed. Perform company-specific cleanup, trigger business process workflows, or execute final configuration steps that depend on completed company upgrade operations.

member.name: O:Table::System#Diagnostics#Database Locks

member.remarks: The Database Locks table is essential for database performance monitoring and troubleshooting concurrency issues in Business Central. This information is crucial for identifying blocking scenarios, deadlock situations, and performance problems caused by lock contention. The table helps administrators and developers understand transaction behavior, optimize concurrency patterns, and resolve blocking issues that can impact system performance. This diagnostic information is vital for maintaining optimal database performance in production environments.

member.name: O:Table::System#Privacy#Privacy Notice

member.remarks: The Code Coverage table is essential for development and testing workflows, providing detailed line-by-line execution tracking for AL code. member.name: O:Table::System#Utilities#Date
member.summary: Virtual table that provides period-based date calculations and date range generation for various time periods. This table enables easy creation of date ranges for weeks, months, quarters, and years.
member.remarks: The Date table is a utility table that automatically generates date periods and ranges for reporting, filtering, and date-based calculations. It provides convenient access to predefined date periods without requiring manual date arithmetic. This table is commonly used in reports, charts, and analytics where data needs to be grouped or filtered by time periods. The table dynamically calculates period boundaries and provides both localized and invariant names for international applications.

member.name: O:Table::System#Utilities#Integer
member.summary: Virtual table that provides an infinite sequence of integer numbers for use in loops, calculations, and data generation. This table is commonly used when you need to iterate over a range of numbers or generate sequential data.
member.remarks: The Integer table is a fundamental utility table that contains an endless sequence of integer values. It's frequently used in AL code for looping operations, generating test data, creating sequences, and performing bulk operations where you need to iterate a specific number of times. The table is virtual and dynamically generates numbers as needed, making it memory-efficient for large ranges. Common usage patterns include FOR loops, data initialization, and report generation.

member.name: O:Interface::System#IUnknown
member.summary: Provides a common base interface that can be implemented by other interfaces for polymorphic behavior. Serves as an optional foundation interface for implementing common interface patterns.
member.remarks: This interface follows the IUnknown pattern commonly used in component-oriented programming. Can be used as a base interface when implementing interface hierarchies or when requiring a common interface type for polymorphic operations across different interface implementations. Contains no methods, serving purely as a marker interface for type compatibility.
